# Proposal: Extend CI fail-fast topology (intra-stage gating + commit-lint gate)

## Problem

`fixCiFailFastTopology` (archived) added the stage-boundary fail-fast edge (`security → test/build`) on PokeEdge-Web. Diagnostic after that change shipped reveals the fix was **incomplete** in two ways:

### 1. Web `test`/`build` don't gate on `commit-lint`

A screenshot from PR #209 (`addTierGatingFoundation`) on 2026-06-17 showed: `Conventional Commit Check` failed in 12s while `Unit Tests & Coverage` (462s) and `Build` (68s) ran to completion. The required `Sharperflow CI Gate` was stuck waiting for the doomed runs.

Run #27703014081: commit-lint failed at `16:11:52Z` (12s); unit tests (455s), build (74s), all 4 security scans (~137s), lint (75s), typecheck (60s) all ran to completion. **Waste: 826s (~13.8 min) per incident.**

`test` and `build` declare `needs: [changes, lint, typecheck, security]` — `commit-lint` is missing.

### 2. Backend stage-3 lanes don't gate on `pr-gate`

PokeEdge backend `pr-gate.yml` has 6 stage-3 lanes all `needs: fast-gate`, all parallel. When `pr-gate` (median 924s) fails (33% of runs), `integration` (157s) + `e2e` (69s) + `acceptance` (124s) + `migration` (81s) all run to completion in parallel — burning 411 wasted runner-seconds per failure.

Run #27699451611: pr-gate failed at `15:32:03Z` (892s); integration (260s), e2e (483s cancelled mid-flight), acceptance (121s), migration (97s) all started at `15:17:15-19Z` and burned 961s after the doomed state was already known. **Waste: 1,858s (~31 min).**

### 3. Web `notify-failure` and `heartbeat` miss commit-lint-only failures

Bonus gap surfaced in discovery: `notify-failure` (ci.yml:334) and `heartbeat` (ci.yml:365) declare `needs: [lint, typecheck, test, build, security]` — `commit-lint` is not in the list. When only commit-lint fails, the leaf jobs succeed → `notify-failure` skips → Discord webhook never fires → team learns of the failure from the GitHub UI, not the configured alert. Heartbeat reports `up` (healthy) for a commit-lint-only failure.

### 4. Standard doesn't cover intra-stage gating

`docs/ci-standard.md` §2 (added in `fixCiFailFastTopology`) covers **stage boundaries** (fast-checks → expensive jobs). It does NOT cover **intra-stage sibling gating** (e.g., stage-3 lanes that share `fast-gate` but don't gate each other on pr-gate failure). Both repos have this gap; the backend's gap is larger because it has more siblings.

## Scope

### Repo 1: `Sharper-Flow/PokeEdge-Web` (direct target, execution-gated)

| File | Line | Change |
|---|---:|---|
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | 163 | `test: needs: [changes, lint, typecheck, security, commit-lint]` |
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | 164 | `test: if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() && needs.changes.outputs.code == 'true' && needs.commit-lint.result != 'failure' }}` |
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | 189 | `build: needs: [changes, lint, typecheck, security, commit-lint]` |
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | 190 | `build: if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() && needs.changes.outputs.code == 'true' && needs.commit-lint.result != 'failure' }}` |
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | 334 | `notify-failure: needs: [lint, typecheck, test, build, security, commit-lint]` |
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | 365 | `heartbeat: needs: [lint, typecheck, test, build, security, commit-lint]` |
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | 375-388 | `HEARTBEAT_STATUS` expression: add `|| needs.commit-lint.result == 'failure'` |

### Repo 2: `Sharper-Flow/PokeEdge` (direct target, execution-gated)

| File | Line | Change |
|---|---:|---|
| `.github/workflows/pr-gate.yml` | 411 (insert after pr-gate) | NEW `stage-3-gate: needs: [fast-gate, pr-gate]`, `if: ${{ !cancelled() }}`, case-loop on `needs.*.result` (success\|skipped only) |
| `.github/workflows/pr-gate.yml` | 415 | `migration-chain: needs: [fast-gate, stage-3-gate]` (keep path-scope `if:`) |
| `.github/workflows/pr-gate.yml` | 472-496 | `contract` unchanged (already path-scope-gated; key off `fast-gate.outputs.openapi`) |
| `.github/workflows/pr-gate.yml` | 498 | `api-compat` unchanged (already chains off contract) |
| `.github/workflows/pr-gate.yml` | 507 | `integration: needs: [fast-gate, stage-3-gate]` (keep path-scope `if:`) |
| `.github/workflows/pr-gate.yml` | 557 | `e2e: needs: [fast-gate, stage-3-gate]` (keep path-scope `if:`) |
| `.github/workflows/pr-gate.yml` | 579 | `acceptance: needs: [fast-gate, stage-3-gate]` (keep path-scope `if:`) |
| `.github/workflows/pr-gate.yml` | 605 | `ci-gate: needs: [..., stage-3-gate, ...]` (add `stage-3-gate` to fan-in) |

### Repo 3: `Sharper-Flow/sharperflow-security-gates` (this repo)

| File | Line | Change |
|---|---:|---|
| `docs/ci-standard.md` | (after §2 Fail-fast edges) | NEW § "Intra-stage sibling gating" subsection: documents the stage-3-gate pattern, the commit-lint `always()` pattern, and the notification-gap fix pattern. Cross-refs PokeEdge backend `pr-gate.yml` and PokeEdge-Web `ci.yml` as canonical examples. |

### Total: 16 file edits across 3 repos + 1 new subsection in 1 file. No new reusable workflows, no new GitHub Actions, no dependency changes.

## Rigor

Strict. Carrying forward from `fixCiFailFastTopology` (C1–C6 reduceActionsCost constraints).

## Out of scope

- PokeEdge-Web full fast-gate join (Fix B in diagnostic) — deferred; Fix C is the minimal-diff alternative
- Backend stage-3 lane consolidation (Design C: merge integration+e2e+acceptance into one job) — strictly worse on failure-localization; rejected in diagnostic
- Push trigger changes — defensible post-merge verification per diagnostic §4
- Path-scope expansion to commit-lint (low-value, defer)
- Renaming `pr-gate` or any job ID (preserves cache hits)
- BuildKit cache cleanup, Stage-3 serialization, deploy-chain (unchanged from prior)

## Open questions for discovery

1. **Backend `stage-3-gate` wall-time penalty on success (+160s = +17%):** is the runner-cost win worth the developer-experience cost? Mitigation: the gate fires instantly (2-min timeout), so developer sees pr-gate failure + sibling skip within seconds of pr-gate completing.
2. **Backend `e2e` cancellation lag:** the diagnostic shows e2e sometimes runs ~483s after pr-gate fails before cancellation propagates. Does `stage-3-gate` failure propagate to e2e fast enough? (Yes — same `needs:` chain that handles pr-gate failure handles stage-3-gate failure.)
3. **Web `always()` pattern: any consumers** that read `needs.test.result` or `needs.build.result` in a way that breaks if test/build are skipped on commit-lint failure? (`ci-gate` already handles it via the case loop.)
4. **Documentation scope:** is one § "Intra-stage sibling gating" enough, or do we need separate subsections for each pattern (stage-gate, commit-lint-always, notification gap)?
5. **PokeEdge-Web Fix B (full fast-gate join) deferred:** confirm acceptable to ship Fix C and revisit if `pytest -x`-style unified patterns gain traction.

# Problem Statement: Extend CI fail-fast topology

## Evidence (5 findings, all from 2026-06-17 diagnostic)

### Finding 1 — Web test/build don't gate on commit-lint (run #27703014081)

```
Conventional Commit Check:  failure  (12s, 16:11:52Z)
Lint & Format:              success
Type Check & API Drift:     success
Security / Gitleaks:        success
Security / OSV:             success
Security / Semgrep JS/TS:   success
Security / Trivy:           success
Unit Tests & Coverage:      success  (462s — wasted, doomed)
Build:                      success  (68s — wasted, doomed)
Sharperflow CI Gate:        failure
```

Source: `/tmp/ci-budget/jobs/web-27703014081.json`. ci.yml:163, 189 — `test`/`build` `needs:` do not include `commit-lint`.

### Finding 2 — Backend stage-3 lanes don't gate on pr-gate (run #27699451611)

```
Fast Gate:                  success  (4s, 15:17:18Z)
PR Gate (unit+api+arch):    failure  (892s, 15:32:03Z)
Integration (Postgres):     success  (260s, 15:17:15Z — wasted, doomed)
E2E Journeys:               cancelled mid-flight (483s, started 15:17:15Z)
Acceptance:                 success  (121s, 15:17:19Z — wasted, doomed)
Migration Chain Validation: success  (97s, 15:17:19Z — wasted, doomed)
Sharperflow CI Gate:        failure
```

Source: `/tmp/ci-budget/jobs/pe-27699451611.json`. pr-gate.yml:415, 507, 557, 579 — 4 stage-3 lanes `needs: fast-gate` only, no `pr-gate` in `needs:`.

### Finding 3 — Web notify-failure/heartbeat skip on commit-lint-only failure

ci.yml:334 `notify-failure: needs: [lint, typecheck, test, build, security]` — no commit-lint. Run #27703014081: all 5 of these jobs succeeded → `notify-failure` `if: failure()` evaluates per-job-failure → no leaf failed → skipped → Discord webhook never fired.

ci.yml:365-388 `heartbeat: needs: [lint, typecheck, test, build, security]`, `HEARTBEAT_STATUS` expression does not include `needs.commit-lint.result`. Heartbeat reports `up` for a commit-lint-only failure.

### Finding 4 — docs/ci-standard.md doesn't cover intra-stage gating

§2 "Fail-fast edges" subsection (added in `fixCiFailFastTopology`) covers **stage boundaries** (fast-checks → expensive jobs). It does NOT cover **intra-stage sibling gating**. Pattern missing: when N expensive lanes share `fast-gate` but don't gate each other on the slowest lane's failure, the fast N-1 lanes waste time on doomed runs.

### Finding 5 — Cost driver analysis (30d window)

Total Actions cost: ~$217.59/mo (PokeEdge $116 + PokeEdge-Web $96 + helpers $6). 92.8% of cost is time overhead; 7.2% is run count. Recoverable from intra-stage waste alone: $13.15/mo (backend) + $3.85/mo (web commit-lint) + $1.60/mo (web build-gates-on-test) = **$18.60/mo (8.6% of budget)**.

Source: `/tmp/ci-budget/analysis/*.py`. Per-PR lifetime cost: $0.61 (Web) and $0.54 (Backend). +1 unique PR/day on both repos = +$34.52/mo. Cost growth outpaces savings if PR volume increases.

## Strict "done" criteria (measurable)

1. Backend `pr-gate.yml` declares a `stage-3-gate: needs: [fast-gate, pr-gate]` join job.
2. Backend `integration`/`e2e`/`acceptance`/`migration-chain` jobs declare `needs: [fast-gate, stage-3-gate]` and retain path-scope `if:`.
3. Web `ci.yml` `test`/`build` `needs:` includes `commit-lint`; `if:` uses `always() && ... && needs.commit-lint.result != 'failure'` pattern.
4. Web `ci.yml` `notify-failure`/`heartbeat` `needs:` includes `commit-lint`; `HEARTBEAT_STATUS` includes `needs.commit-lint.result == 'failure'`.
5. `docs/ci-standard.md` adds "Intra-stage sibling gating" subsection documenting the patterns from criteria 1-4.
6. actionlint clean on all touched workflow files (EXIT:0).
7. PR-triggered runs (the dominant cost class) on both repos post-change show: web commit-lint failure → test/build skipped in <60s; backend pr-gate failure → integration/e2e/acceptance/migration skipped in <5s.

# Agreement: Extend CI fail-fast topology (stage-3 gate + commit-lint)

## Objectives

### O1 — PokeEdge-Web: `test`/`build` gate on `commit-lint` failure
A `Conventional Commit Check` failure skips `test` and `build` instead of running them to completion. PR runs only — push/merge_group events unaffected (commit-lint doesn't run on those, `always()` pattern preserves skip-cascade).

### O2 — PokeEdge-Web: notification gap fix
`notify-failure` and `heartbeat` `needs:` include `commit-lint`. A commit-lint-only failure now fires the Discord webhook AND reports Uptime Kuma `down` (was silently `up`).

### O3 — PokeEdge backend: stage-3-gate join
New `stage-3-gate: needs: [fast-gate, pr-gate]` join job. `integration`/`e2e`/`acceptance`/`migration-chain` declare `needs: [fast-gate, stage-3-gate]` (keep `fast-gate` for path-scope outputs). A `pr-gate` failure now skips the 4 sibling lanes within ~3s of pr-gate failing (vs 411s median waste currently).

### O4 — `docs/ci-standard.md` documents intra-stage gating
New § "Intra-stage sibling gating" subsection documents:
- The stage-3-gate pattern (cross-ref PokeEdge backend pr-gate.yml)
- The commit-lint `always()` pattern (cross-ref PokeEdge-Web ci.yml)
- The notification-gap pattern (commit-lint in notify/heartbeat needs:)

## Acceptance criteria

### AC1 — PokeEdge-Web ci.yml topology (commit-lint gate)
- `test` `needs:` includes `commit-lint`.
- `test` `if:` uses `always() && !cancelled() && needs.changes.outputs.code == 'true' && needs.commit-lint.result != 'failure'`.
- `build` `needs:` includes `commit-lint`.
- `build` `if:` matches test pattern.
- `ci-gate` `needs:` and case loop unchanged.
- actionlint clean.
- **Evidence:** sampled failed PR run on PokeEdge-Web shows test/build SKIPPED (not run-to-completion) when commit-lint fails.

### AC2 — PokeEdge-Web ci.yml topology (notification gap)
- `notify-failure` `needs:` includes `commit-lint`.
- `heartbeat` `needs:` includes `commit-lint`.
- `HEARTBEAT_STATUS` expression includes `|| needs.commit-lint.result == 'failure'`.
- `notify-failure` and `heartbeat` still respect path-scope via `if:` (commit-lint SKIPPED on push → notify/heartbeat must still run if needed). Verify with actionlint.
- actionlint clean.

### AC3 — PokeEdge pr-gate.yml topology (stage-3-gate)
- New `stage-3-gate` job exists, `needs: [fast-gate, pr-gate]`, `if: ${{ !cancelled() }}`, case-loop on `needs.*.result` accepting `success|skipped`.
- `migration-chain`, `integration`, `e2e`, `acceptance` `needs: [fast-gate, stage-3-gate]` (keep path-scope `if:`).
- `contract` and `api-compat` unchanged.
- `ci-gate` `needs:` adds `stage-3-gate` to the fan-in.
- actionlint clean.
- **Evidence:** sampled failed pr-gate run on PokeEdge shows integration/e2e/acceptance/migration SKIPPED within ~3s of pr-gate failing.

### AC4 — Measurable savings (post-merge)
- PokeEdge-Web: post-change PR run with commit-lint failure shows test/build SKIPPED in <60s.
- PokeEdge: post-change pr-gate failure shows integration/e2e/acceptance/migration SKIPPED in <5s.
- Reported in acceptance evidence (run IDs + job conclusions).

### AC5 — No security-posture weakening
- No scanner removed or made advisory.
- No severity threshold raised.
- No skip-on-failure introduced on security scanners.

### AC6 — Reusable job names and `Sharperflow CI Gate` context frozen
- `Sharperflow CI Gate` job name unchanged in both app repos.
- `pr-gate`, `commit-lint`, `fast-gate`, `test`, `build`, `security`, `ci-gate` job IDs unchanged (preserves cache hits, downstream references).

### AC7 — actionlint clean
All touched workflow files pass `docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/repo" --workdir /repo rhysd/actionlint:1.7.7` in their respective repos.

### AC8 — Standard docs updated
- `docs/ci-standard.md` § "Intra-stage sibling gating" subsection exists after §2 Fail-fast edges.
- Documents stage-3-gate pattern, commit-lint `always()` pattern, notification-gap pattern.
- Cross-references PokeEdge backend pr-gate.yml and PokeEdge-Web ci.yml as canonical examples.

## Constraints

### C1-C6 — Carried from reduceActionsCost / fixCiFailFastTopology
C1 no security weakening · C2 no job-name rename · C3 no GHAS/CodeQL/SonarCloud · C4 no slow-check deletion · C5 no skipped-job-as-free assumption · C6 no app-repo/reusable-gate conflation.

### C7 — Cross-repo execution requires explicit user approval at execution gate
PokeEdge-Web and PokeEdge are direct-target repos. Execution gate requires explicit user approval before any edit to either remote repo.

### C8 — Worktree isolation
This repo's docs edits go through ADV worktree. App repo edits go through their respective worktrees.

### C9 — Trade-off surfaced and accepted
Backend `stage-3-gate` introduces a +160s (+17%) wall-time penalty on success runs (critical path extends from 924s to 1,084s). This is the cost of the runner-cost win on failure. User explicitly accepted this trade-off at proposal gate. Implementation must not optimize away this trade-off without re-approval.

### C10 — Skip-cascade preservation is mandatory
Each modified stage-3 lane MUST keep `fast-gate` in its `needs:` so it can read path-scope `outputs.*` (verified by actionlint). The `stage-3-gate` failure must not bypass path-scope skip for docs-only PRs. Diagnostic §2 (skip-cascade correctness) must hold.

## Avoidances

### A1 — Do not change backend wall-time penalty decision without re-approval
The +160s/+17% trade-off was explicitly accepted. Implementation must not introduce additional serialization that worsens this without re-approval.

### A2 — Do not touch `contract` or `api-compat` topology
Both are correctly path-scope-gated already. `contract: needs: fast-gate, if: openapi`. `api-compat: needs: contract`. Adding `stage-3-gate` to these would regress path-scope skip behavior.

### A3 — Do not remove or weaken the `pytest -x` flag from parent change
`pr-gate.yml` unit + api lanes have `-x` from `fixCiFailFastTopology`. Preserved unchanged.

### A4 — Do not adopt PokeEdge-Web Fix B (full fast-gate join) in this change
Fix C (minimal-diff, `always()` pattern) ships first. Fix B is a bigger refactor — separate change if needed.

### A5 — Do not consolidate stage-3 lanes into one job (Design C)
Design C (merge integration+e2e+acceptance into one job) is strictly worse on failure-localization per diagnostic §4. Rejected.

### A6 — Do not rename `pr-gate` or other job IDs
Preserves cache hits and downstream references (e.g., the `pr-gate` name appears in monitoring labels, branch protection contexts, etc.).

### A7 — Do not touch `push` trigger on PokeEdge-Web ci.yml
Push trigger is defensible post-merge verification per diagnostic §4. Don't remove.

### A8 — Do not add `commit-lint` to the test/build `needs:` without the `always()` + `result != 'failure'` `if:` pattern
Direct addition (no `always()`) would silently break push and merge_group events per diagnostic §3 (Fix A rejected).

### A9 — Do not touch `pytest -x` or `concurrency: cancel-in-progress` on dependency-review.yml
Those landed in `fixCiFailFastTopology` and are working. Preserve unchanged.

## Out of scope

- PokeEdge-Web full fast-gate join (Fix B) — separate change
- Backend lane consolidation (Design C) — rejected
- Push trigger changes — defensible post-merge verification
- Path-scope expansion to commit-lint (low value)
- Job ID renames — preserves cache hits
- BuildKit cache cleanup, Stage-3 sibling isolation, deploy-chain — unchanged from prior changes
- Adding new scanner or threshold changes — C1/C5
- PokyEdge backend pin (stale v0.3.2) — separate change
- Advance pilot `@v0` floating tag — different gap class

# Design: Extend CI fail-fast topology (stage-3 gate + commit-lint)

## Architecture

### Three-repo change, fast-follow of `fixCiFailFastTopology`

```
extendCiFailFastTopologyStage3 (primary change in sharperflow-security-gates)
├── Surface 1: THIS REPO (sharperflow-security-gates)
│   └── docs/ci-standard.md § "Intra-stage sibling gating" subsection (NEW)
│   └── Worktree: ADV change/extendCiFailFastTopologyStage3
│
├── Surface 2: PokeEdge-Web (direct target, execution-gated)
│   ├── .github/workflows/ci.yml:163-164 (test commit-lint gate, Fix C)
│   ├── .github/workflows/ci.yml:189-190 (build commit-lint gate, Fix C)
│   ├── .github/workflows/ci.yml:334 (notify-failure needs += commit-lint)
│   ├── .github/workflows/ci.yml:365 (heartbeat needs += commit-lint)
│   └── .github/workflows/ci.yml:375-388 (HEARTBEAT_STATUS expression)
│   └── Worktree: manual in PokeEdge-Web repo
│
└── Surface 3: PokeEdge (direct target, execution-gated)
    ├── .github/workflows/pr-gate.yml:411 (NEW stage-3-gate job)
    ├── .github/workflows/pr-gate.yml:415 (migration-chain needs)
    ├── .github/workflows/pr-gate.yml:507 (integration needs)
    ├── .github/workflows/pr-gate.yml:557 (e2e needs)
    ├── .github/workflows/pr-gate.yml:579 (acceptance needs)
    └── .github/workflows/pr-gate.yml:605 (ci-gate needs)
    └── Worktree: manual in PokeEdge repo
```

Inherits the parent change's branch model. New branch `change/extendCiFailFastTopologyStage3` for this repo; new branches in app repos.

### Verification model

Per-repo actionlint + post-change CI evidence. No shared test suite.

---

## LBP decisions

### LBP-1: Backend `stage-3-gate` is Design B (gate join), NOT Design C (lane consolidation)

**Decision:** New `stage-3-gate: needs: [fast-gate, pr-gate]` join job. 4 stage-3 lanes (`integration`, `e2e`, `acceptance`, `migration-chain`) update to `needs: [fast-gate, stage-3-gate]`. `contract` and `api-compat` unchanged.

**Rationale (validated by diagnostic):**
- Wall-time on success: 924s → 1,084s (+160s, +17%). User accepted this trade-off (C9).
- Runner-seconds on success: 5,544s → 1,555s (−3,989s, −72%).
- Runner-seconds on failure: 5,760s → 963s (−4,797s, −83%).
- Skip-cascade: each lane keeps `fast-gate` in `needs:` to read `outputs.tests`/`migrations`/`openapi` for path-scope `if:` (C10 mandatory).
- Design C (merge lanes) is dominated by Design B on every metric except per-lane failure localization, which C loses (diagnostic §4).

**Skip-cascade correctness (per diagnostic §2):** when pr-gate is SKIPPED (path-scope clean), `stage-3-gate` accepts `skipped` via its case-loop, but each lane's `if: needs.fast-gate.outputs.X == 'true'` independently skips it. The case-loop alone is NOT sufficient — path-scope is preserved by the per-lane `if:`.

**`stage-3-gate` job body (mirrors `fast-gate` pattern):**

```yaml
stage-3-gate:
  needs: [fast-gate, pr-gate]
  if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
  name: Stage 3 Gate
  runs-on: ubuntu-latest
  timeout-minutes: 2
  permissions: {}
  steps:
    - name: Verify stage 3 prerequisites
      env:
        FAST_GATE_RESULT: ${{ needs.fast-gate.result }}
        PR_GATE_RESULT: ${{ needs.pr-gate.result }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        for result in \
          "fast-gate=${FAST_GATE_RESULT}" \
          "pr-gate=${PR_GATE_RESULT}"; do
          job="${result%%=*}"
          status="${result#*=}"
          echo "${job}: ${status}"
          case "${status}" in
            success|skipped) ;;
            *)
              echo "::error::Stage 3 gate blocked by ${job} (${status}). Skipping remaining lanes."
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac
        done
        echo "Stage 3 gate passed — proceeding to remaining lanes."
```

### LBP-2: Web uses Fix C (`always()` + `result != 'failure'`), NOT Fix A or Fix B

**Decision:** Add `commit-lint` to test/build `needs:`, change `if:` to use `always() && !cancelled() && needs.changes.outputs.code == 'true' && needs.commit-lint.result != 'failure'`.

**Rationale (validated by diagnostic §3):**
- Fix A (direct add without `always()`) breaks push/merge_group events because `commit-lint` has `if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'` and gets SKIPPED on those events → test/build skip too.
- Fix B (full fast-gate join) works but is bigger refactor. Deferred (A4).
- Fix C is minimal-diff: 2 jobs touched (test, build), no new job, no rename. `always()` allows `if:` to evaluate when needs are skipped. `'skipped' != 'failure'` makes push/merge_group behave correctly.

**Concrete edits:**

```yaml
# ci.yml:163-164 (test)
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck, security, commit-lint]
    if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() && needs.changes.outputs.code == 'true' && needs.commit-lint.result != 'failure' }}

# ci.yml:189-190 (build)
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck, security, commit-lint]
    if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() && needs.changes.outputs.code == 'true' && needs.commit-lint.result != 'failure' }}
```

### LBP-3: Notification gap fix — add commit-lint to needs: AND to `HEARTBEAT_STATUS`

**Decision:** Add `commit-lint` to:
- `notify-failure: needs: [lint, typecheck, test, build, security, commit-lint]` (ci.yml:334)
- `heartbeat: needs: [lint, typecheck, test, build, security, commit-lint]` (ci.yml:365)
- `HEARTBEAT_STATUS` expression: add `|| needs.commit-lint.result == 'failure'` (ci.yml:375)

**Rationale:** Without commit-lint in `needs:`, the leaf jobs succeed when only commit-lint fails → `notify-failure` skips → no Discord webhook. Heartbeat reports `up` (healthy). After this change, commit-lint failure propagates to both jobs.

**Subtlety:** `notify-failure` has `if: failure() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'` — main-branch only. On PR, notify-failure never fires regardless. The change affects main-branch push runs that include commit-lint (currently commit-lint is PR-only, so this only matters if/when commit-lint is extended to push). Heartbeat affects all branches because of `if: always()`.

### LBP-4: Docs — single § "Intra-stage sibling gating" covering all 3 patterns

**Decision:** One subsection in `docs/ci-standard.md` after §2 "Fail-fast edges", covering:
1. **Stage-3-gate pattern** (Backend's `stage-3-gate` join) — for many expensive lanes under `fast-gate` that need to gate on the slowest one.
2. **Commit-lint `always()` pattern** (Web's Fix C) — for adding a PR-only fast lane to test/build `needs:` without breaking push events.
3. **Notification-gap pattern** (commit-lint in notify/heartbeat `needs:`) — for ensuring summary-only failures still fire configured alerts.

**Rationale:** All three patterns are intra-stage sibling gating concerns. One subsection keeps the standard cohesive (P04). Cross-reference backend pr-gate.yml and web ci.yml as canonical examples.

### LBP-5: Task breakdown by surface, sequential within worktree

| Task | Surface | Worktree | Blocked by |
|---|---|---|---|
| T1 | docs/ci-standard.md § "Intra-stage sibling gating" | this repo (ADV) | — |
| T2 | PokeEdge-Web ci.yml test/build commit-lint gate (Fix C) | PokeEdge-Web | — |
| T3 | PokeEdge-Web ci.yml notify-failure/heartbeat (commit-lint in needs + heartbeat expression) | PokeEdge-Web | — |
| T4 | PokeEdge pr-gate.yml: add stage-3-gate job | PokeEdge | — |
| T5 | PokeEdge pr-gate.yml: update 4 stage-3 lanes needs: | PokeEdge | T4 |
| T6 | PokeEdge pr-gate.yml: update ci-gate needs: | PokeEdge | T4 |
| T7 | actionlint verification (3 repos) + post-merge CI evidence | all | T1-T6 |

T2/T3 same file (ci.yml), sequential in same worktree. T4→T5/T6 same file (pr-gate.yml), sequential.

---

## Implementation strategy

### Phase 1 — This repo (no execution-gate approval)

1. T1: Edit `docs/ci-standard.md` to add § "Intra-stage sibling gating" subsection (after §2).
2. Run actionlint on the doc (no-op for markdown, just review).
3. Commit + push to ADV worktree.

### Phase 2 — PokeEdge-Web (execution-gate approval)

1. Create worktree in PokeEdge-Web repo: `change/extendCiFailFastTopologyStage3` from main.
2. T2: Edit ci.yml:163-164 (test) and ci.yml:189-190 (build).
3. T3: Edit ci.yml:334 (notify-failure), ci.yml:365 (heartbeat), ci.yml:375 (HEARTBEAT_STATUS).
4. Run actionlint on ci.yml.
5. Commit, push, PR to PokeEdge-Web.

### Phase 3 — PokeEdge (execution-gate approval)

1. Create worktree in PokeEdge repo: `change/extendCiFailFastTopologyStage3` from main.
2. T4: Insert `stage-3-gate` job after pr-gate (line 411).
3. T5: Edit pr-gate.yml:415 (migration-chain), 507 (integration), 557 (e2e), 579 (acceptance) — add `stage-3-gate` to `needs:`.
4. T6: Edit pr-gate.yml:605 (ci-gate) — add `stage-3-gate` to `needs:`.
5. Run actionlint on pr-gate.yml.
6. Commit, push, PR to PokeEdge.

### Phase 4 — Verification

1. actionlint clean on all 3 repos (touched files).
2. Post-merge CI evidence:
   - PokeEdge-Web: sample a commit-lint failure PR run → test/build SKIPPED in <60s.
   - PokeEdge: sample a pr-gate failure run → integration/e2e/acceptance/migration SKIPPED in <5s.

### Risk register

| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| `always()` + `needs.commit-lint.result` evaluation order on undefined state | `commit-lint` is in `needs:`, runner always sets result to `success`/`failure`/`skipped`. actionlint verified. |
| `stage-3-gate` regresses path-scope skip | Each lane keeps `fast-gate` in `needs:` for outputs. C10 mandatory. |
| Backend +160s wall-time penalty degrades DX | User accepted (C9). Documented in standard. |
| Notification fix has subtle interaction with path-scope skip | Heartbeat already handles skipped via `if: always()`. actionlint will catch any regression. |
| e2e cancellation lag on backend | `stage-3-gate` failure propagates same as `pr-gate` failure via `needs:` chain. ~3s propagation, vs 411s median waste currently. |
| `pytest -x` flag accidentally removed | A3 mandatory — preserved unchanged. Verified in T5 (only needs: change, not run body). |

### Validator questions (inline validation)

All technical claims already validated by the parent change's diagnostic. Re-verifying for this change's specific patterns:

1. **`always()` in `if:` overrides skip-cascade:** per [docs.github.com](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-jobs/using-jobs-in-a-workflow), `always()` allows the job to evaluate `if:` even when needs are skipped. Validated.
2. **`needs.*.result` safe to reference for skipped jobs:** per docs, runner always sets result to one of `success`/`failure`/`skipped`/`cancelled`. Never undefined. Validated.
3. **Skip-cascade via `!cancelled()` + case-loop on `needs.*.result`:** the `fast-gate` job in the same file already uses this pattern. `stage-3-gate` mirrors it. Validated.
4. **`stage-3-gate` as a join with no `outputs:`:** downstream lanes key off `fast-gate.outputs.*`, not `stage-3-gate`. No outputs needed. Validated.
5. **actionlint accepts all 3 patterns:** validated by parent change's diagnostic worker (Fix A/B/C all exit 0, full topology with skip-cascade retention validated).
6. **`HEARTBEAT_STATUS` expression with `||` chain:** standard YAML. The `||` is in `${{ }}` expression, actionlint doesn't lint expressions but does check syntax. Validated.
documents.executiveSummary:
# Executive Summary: Extend CI fail-fast topology (stage-3 gate + commit-lint)

## Outcome
Closed the intra-stage fail-fast gap that the parent change (`fixCiFailFastTopology`) missed: backend stage-3 lanes now skip when `pr-gate` fails; Web `test`/`build`/`notify-failure`/`heartbeat` now gate on `commit-lint`; standard documents all three patterns.

## What shipped

### sharperflow-security-gates (committed `c8400c6` in ADV worktree)
- `docs/ci-standard.md` § "Intra-stage sibling gating" — 118 lines documenting:
  - Stage-3-gate join pattern (with skip-cascade mandatory requirement)
  - Commit-lint `always()` pattern (with full behavior matrix for pr/push/merge_group)
  - Notification-gap pattern (notify/heartbeat needs: + HEARTBEAT_STATUS expression)
  - Cross-references to backend pr-gate.yml and web ci.yml as canonical examples

### PokeEdge-Web (PR #211, head `9fde4af1`)
- `ci.yml:163-164, 189-190`: test/build `needs:` += `commit-lint`; `if:` uses `always() && !cancelled() && needs.changes.outputs.code == 'true' && needs.commit-lint.result != 'failure'`
- `ci.yml:334, 365`: notify-failure/heartbeat `needs:` += `commit-lint`
- `ci.yml:380`: `HEARTBEAT_STATUS` expression includes `|| needs.commit-lint.result == 'failure'`
- actionlint clean (EXIT:0)
- CI: Lint ✓, Security all 4 ✓, Changes ✓, Commit Check ✓, **Type Check ✗ (pre-existing openapi.json drift)**, Build pending, Unit Tests pending

### PokeEdge (PR #512, head `b943ea1c6`)
- `pr-gate.yml:411` (new): `stage-3-gate: needs: [fast-gate, pr-gate]`, `if: !cancelled()`, case-loop on `needs.*.result` accepting `success|skipped`
- `pr-gate.yml:415, 507, 557, 579`: migration-chain/integration/e2e/acceptance `needs: [fast-gate, stage-3-gate]` (keep `fast-gate` for path-scope outputs)
- `pr-gate.yml:605`: `ci-gate` `needs:` += `stage-3-gate`
- `contract` and `api-compat` unchanged (A2)
- actionlint clean (EXIT:0)
- Pre-push hooks all passed
- CI: Sharperflow CI Gate ✓, **Stage 3 Gate ✓ in 3s**, Fast Gate ✓, Quality Chain ✓, Security all 4 ✓. Stage-3 lanes correctly SKIP on this workflow-only PR (path-scope working).

## Trade-off
**Backend `stage-3-gate` adds +160s (+17%) to success-path wall-time** (924s → 1,084s). User explicitly accepted in C9. On failure: 411s runner-seconds saved per pr-gate failure.

## Estimated savings
- Backend: **$13.15/mo** (240 pr-gate failures × 411s × $0.008/min)
- Web commit-lint: **$3.85/mo** (35 incidents × 530s × $0.008/min)
- Web build→test gate: **$1.60/mo** (200s × 311 failures × 0.57 × $0.008/min)
- **Total: $18.60/mo (8.6% of $217/mo budget)**

## Constraints honored
- C1-C6 (carried from reduceActionsCost): all respected
- C7 (cross-repo execution approval): user-approved at execution gate
- C8 (worktree isolation): ADV worktree for this repo, manual worktrees for app repos
- C9 (trade-off surfaced+accepted): implementation did not optimize away the wall-time penalty
- C10 (skip-cascade mandatory): fast-gate retained in every stage-3 lane's `needs:`; case-loop is complement, not replacement

## Out of scope (per OOS1-OOS9)
- PokeEdge-Web Fix B (full fast-gate join)
- Backend lane consolidation (Design C)
- Push trigger changes
- Path-scope expansion to commit-lint
- Job ID renames
- BuildKit/deploy-chain
- New scanner or threshold changes
- PokeEdge backend pin (stale v0.3.2)
- Advance pilot `@v0`

## Remaining (post-merge evidence, AC4)
- Web: next commit-lint failure PR run → test/build SKIPPED in <60s
- Backend: next pr-gate failure run → integration/e2e/acceptance/migration SKIPPED in <5s
- Both require PRs to merge first

## Pre-existing issue surfaced
**PokeEdge-Web `docs/openapi.json` is out of sync with backend `openapi.json` main.** Type Check & API Drift fails on any PR opened against current main. This is **NOT in scope** for this change and is a separate maintenance task. PR #211 will be blocked by this until someone regenerates `docs/openapi.json` from backend main. Options for the user:
1. Regenerate `docs/openapi.json` as a separate commit on PR #211 (small YAML regeneration)
2. Land `docs/openapi.json` regeneration as a separate PR first, then rebase #211
3. Land the commit-lint changes in a follow-up PR after regeneration
